description: This file defines the interface `FeatureProperties` in a Java project, which represents data related to features. It provides methods for creating and manipulating feature property objects, which are JSON-like data structures, and includes methods for setting values, removing fields, and converting to JSON. The interface extends other interfaces for JSON handling and immutability.

classes.name: FeatureProperties
classes.description: An immutable interface representing feature-related properties, allowing creation, modification, and JSON conversion of feature data.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current `FeatureProperties` for modification.

methods.name: setValue (CharSequence, int)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with an integer value.

methods.name: setValue (CharSequence, long)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with a long value.

methods.name: setValue (CharSequence, double)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with a double value.

methods.name: setValue (CharSequence, boolean)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with a boolean value.

methods.name: setValue (CharSequence, String)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with a String value.

methods.name: setValue (CharSequence, JsonValue)
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with a JsonValue.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a given JsonField.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from an iterable of JsonFields.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field with the specified key.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the feature properties to a JsonObject, optionally filtered by a field selector and schema version.
